study: Greenson et al. 2009 (Am J Surg Pathol)
reader_type: Pathologist review feeding two logistic regression models
performance: 85.4% vs 85.0% probability of correct MSI-H classification; ~43% of CRCs scored <=1 with <3% MSI-H likelihood

study: Hyde et al. 2010 (Am J Surg Pathol) - PREDICT
reader_type: Pathologist-scored histology model, independent pathologist validation
performance: in that cohort MsPath sens 92.1% / spec 37.8%; Revised Bethesda sens 81.3% / spec 39.5%; PREDICT developed to improve on both (own values not in abstract)
model_comparison: Compares two human scoring systems; no AI

reader_type: Five gastrointestinal pathologists, blinded, class-balanced subset

model_comparison: MSINet AUROC 0.865 (0.735-0.995) on the same 40 cases - model exceeded pathologists

reader_type: Automated scoring of the human-defined MS-Path histologic features
